name: Prada Sport Linea Rossa F/W 1999 black dyed kid fur nylon vest
description: Prada Sport Linea Rossa F/W 1999 black dyed kid fur nylon vest. It has two outside and two inside pockets, zip and velcro fastening. It has a removable nylon hood from under the neck and a waist belt, which can be removed. Signature branding on all the perfectly functional, timeless and comfortable Miuccia Prada staple piece. The vest has been presented in both 1999 men's and women's runway shows in different versions. It also appears in different Prada advertisements.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier S/S 2005 arabic print mesh long sleeve
description: Jean Paul Gaultier S/S 2005 arabic print mesh long sleeve, with black knitted laced mohair collar and cuffs. The print shows Sanskrit letters in a copper-red and brown-black circle on a beige background. Shoulders and side seams in black wool. Laser-cut bottom hem. The same cross motif is present in the fashion show. Made in Italy.

name: Roberto Cavalli F/W 2003 midi skirt made of burnt-effect eroded leather
description: Roberto Cavalli F/W 2003 midi skirt made of burnt-effect eroded leather. The burnt leather finish gives it a unique worn effect, making it an extremely rare and iconic piece. Made in Italy.

name: Dolce & Gabbana F/W 2003 tornado zip turtleneck
description: Dolce & Gabbana F/W 2003 tornado zip turtleneck. An extremely heavyweight black virgin wool, featuring a two-way zipper that wraps around the body from the neck to the hem, this allows for endless custom-ability of the fit.

name: Prada Sport Linea Rossa early 2000 techwear bowling nylon bag
description: Prada Sport Linea Rossa early 2000 techwear bowling nylon bag.

name: Dolce & Gabbana S/S 1992 black chenille and lace boned corset bodysuit
description: Dolce & Gabbana S/S 1992 black chenille and lace boned corset bodysuit embellished with lace ruffles, deadstock. Made in Italy.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier F/W 1998 'Eskimo' print mesh hoodie deadstock
description: Jean Paul Gaultier F/W 1998 'Eskimo' print mesh hoodie deadstock. The piece presented at the men runaway show, features a captivating all-over print resembling a classic painting, likely depicting a historic battle scene with a crowd of people in the snow below the blue and brown of the sky that is showing heavenly figures inspired by 'The Creation of Adam'. It has mohair trims detailing wrist and hood. Made in Italy. deadstock.

name: Maison Martin Margiela Resort 2012 black fringed necklace
description: Maison Martin Margiela Resort 2012 black fringed necklace, featuring a back tie fastening that consent an adjustable fit. Margiela Resort Collection distinguish for cascades of silky fringe on collars or waistcoats that echoed feathered boas. The collier is a unique piece of elegance and sophistication.

name: Roberto Cavalli F/W 1999 blue furry cow print pants
description: Roberto Cavalli F/W 1999 blue furry cow print pants, five pockets and zip closure at front. Presented on the runway in a brown color, this blue version is more rare.

name: D&G F/W 2004 'Sex Is My Favourite Business' set
description: D&G F/W 2004 long-sleeve top and distressed denim mini skirt set with the iconic 'Sex Is My Favourite Business' graphic.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier F/W 2000 Mondrian colorblock patchwork sheer mesh top.
description: Jean Paul Gaultier F/W 2000 Mondrian colorblock patchwork sheer mesh top. Stretch mesh in a variety of lovely colors, patchwork pieced in a Mondrian manner. Contrasting black seams in fuzzy wool. Made in Italy.

name: Miu Miu S/S 1999 red nylon waist bag
description: Miu Miu S/S 1999 red nylon waist bag deadstock. Presented in the runway show in different colours and versions it has two compartments and adjustable velcro fastener, allowing it to fit any size. Designed with a red nylon surface and synthetic honeycomb backing, the bag has a distintive appearance. Lightweight and adaptable, it is perfect for everyday use. A meticulous and avant-garde creation combining innovative textures. Embossed logo on the front. The bag still has tags.

name: D&G S/S 2004 strappy bondage corset suit
description: D&G S/S 2004 scrappy bondage corset suit. Textured corset suit cut in cotton twill, lace, rib and pointelle with built-in boned corset bodice creates a sexy silhouette. Snap front with rivets and side lace-up detailing creates an easy-yet corset. Seamed bust cups with lace trim add to the lingerie-inspired style. Present in the runway show in different versions.

name: 90s Claude Montana black wool with asymmetrical fur coat
description: 90s Claude Montana Paris black wool with asymmetrical fur coat. Single-breasted closure with visible buttons and front patch pockets with flap.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier F/W 2003 bondage parachute long-sleeve shirt
description: Jean Paul Gaultier F/W 2003 bondage parachute long-sleeve shirt. Intersected straps all over it, adjustable with a metallic button. Small Gaultier logo on the back. Double paneled shoulders. Amazing brown color, Made in Italy.

name: MM6 F/W 2005-06 shoulder bag with five detachable cargo pockets
description: Maison Martin Margiela MM6 F/W 2005-2006 shoulder bag with five detachable cargo pockets in dark brown leather. Made in Italy.

name: Roberto Cavalli F/W 2001 oriental carpet print pants
description: Roberto Cavalli F/W 2001 oriental carpet print pants with gold glitters details, five pockets and zip closure at front.

name: Helmut Lang F/W 1999 Astro jacket
description: Helmut Lang F/W 1999 Astro jacket. Expertly designed by Helmut Lang, this iconic Astro jacket from the 1999 runway collection is crafted in light tan cotton and features a detachable faux fur collar. The jacket is quilted and lined with a concealed interior pocket. The collar has wire at the interior allowing you to lift the collar or to fold it down; it additionally features a drawstring pull and a veltro tab at the front the collar. This coat has numerous details including vertical pockets, zippers at the wrists.

name: Moschino S/S 2000 set hand-painted canvas
description: Moschino S/S 2000 jacket and skirt, the amazing set is made of hand-painted canvas. It's enriched with details such as fringes and flower-shaped sequins. A perfect example of Moschino's exuberant creativity and playful style. The runway background is the motif of the suit print.

name: Maison Martin Margiela F/W 2000 Artisanal black leather necklace
description: Maison Martin Margiela F/W 2000 Artisanal 'white label' black leather necklace featuring a hook-and-eye closure and an adjustable fit.

name: Dsquared2 S/S 2004 pink denim bustier top
description: Dsquared2 S/S 2004 pink denim bustier top. Sexy and rare top in pink strapless denim bustier/corset style! Two large zips on the front bodice and a metal zip on the back. Two buttons on each side of the waist to adjust it.

name: Emporio Armani S/S 2003 orange silk waistcoat embroidered
description: Emporio Armani S/S 2003 orange silk waistcoat embroidered with a cascade of sequin threads and beads. Made in Italy.

name: D&G F/W 2003 combat cargo set
description: D&G F/W 2003 combat cargo set. One of the most unique D&G cargo pants, made with corduroy and a double layer of polyurethane that can be rolled up. Each cargo pocket has two additional small pockets built in, made with the same material of the layer, for a total of 10 pockets. The layer feature six small metallic transpiring holes. Trucker jacket, zippers to sleeves and chest, multi pocket sleeve incredible detailing and quality, lightweight quilted lining.

name: Gucci S/S 1996 colour printed cotton straight leg pants
description: Gucci x Tom Ford S/S 1996 colour printed cotton straight leg pants. This 1970s inspired collection featured the same print in blue in the runway presentation and in the season's ad campaign, shot by Mario Testino. The trousers features different shades of blue and white watercolour print with the Gucci logo peppered throughout.
